_readme: Italian photo captions, keyed by IATA then image file name.
Translated from the English captions in public/photos/captions/<IATA>.json.
lib/airport-photos.ts reads this file as captions.it.json; airports or files
missing here fall back to the English caption, never to the Chinese one.
